summary.text: Tom Walton is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 28, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican David Young.

Born in Cedar Falls, he holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa (1986) and a law degree from the University of Iowa College of Law (1989), and his listed profession is director of legal services and general counsel.
